Azam Khan Granted Bail in ED Case, Allahabad HC Calls Arrest 'Motivated'

Azam Khan has been granted bail in a case registered by the Enforcement Directorate (ED). The Allahabad High Court, while granting bail, stated that the arrest was 'motivated'. The Supreme Court, however, refused to pause Azam Khan's interim bail, with the bench indicating it would list the matter for hearing. Separately, the Allahabad High Court had reserved its verdict on Azam Khan's plea challenging his ED arrest in the Rs 426-crore Jauhar Trust case.
